practice.title: Provision-and-verify: Declarative Configuration
steps: Sketch the architecture for Declarative Configuration and list what must be configured.
Provision it in an isolated environment using an isolated dev account/namespace and infrastructure-as-code.
Tear it down and rebuild it from your notes — then fix whatever you had to guess.

projects.title: Mini-project: apply Declarative Configuration

outcomes: Working IaC/config files plus a runbook.

extensions: Re-do it under one changed constraint (scale, tolerance, budget, or dataset) and compare the outcome.

details.description: Security is a core topic in GitOps. Mastering it builds foundational competence for the role.

overview.whatIsIt: Security is a fundamental concept in GitOps work.
whyMatters: Understanding Security is essential for performing GitOps responsibilities effectively.
prerequisites: Understanding of preceding topics in this roadmap
overview.outcome: You will be able to apply Security knowledge in real GitOps work and discuss it confidently.

details.whyLearn: Security is a core skill for GitOps — interviewers and teams expect competence here.
objectives: Be ready to discuss it in interviews

practice.title: Provision-and-verify: Security
steps: Sketch the architecture for Security and list what must be configured.
Provision it in an isolated environment using an isolated dev account/namespace and infrastructure-as-code.
Tear it down and rebuild it from your notes — then fix whatever you had to guess.
practice.description: A self-contained exercise on Security for GitOps. Finish it by checking that the environment rebuilds from scratch and the health check passes.

projects.title: Mini-project: apply Security
projects.description: Apply Security for GitOps and produce a reproducible deployment with all configuration under version control. Then check that the environment rebuilds from scratch and the health check passes.
projects.goal: Demonstrate working command of Security by producing a reproducible deployment with all configuration under version control and verifying that the environment rebuilds from scratch and the health check passes.
requirements: A reproducible deployment with all configuration under version control that genuinely applies Security for GitOps.
Record the inputs, assumptions, and exact steps you followed.
State the evidence that it works: the environment rebuilds from scratch and the health check passes.
outcomes: Working IaC/config files plus a runbook.
A short written explanation of Security you could defend in a review or interview.
extensions: Re-do it under one changed constraint (scale, tolerance, budget, or dataset) and compare the outcome.

interviewQuestions: Explain Security to a beginner in simple terms.

What is a common mistake people make with Security?
details.careerRelevance: Directly relevant to GitOps — expect this in interviews and daily work.
